name: Australia Internet Solutions
summary: Melbourne dialup/ISDN + leased line/frame relay to 2Mb + hosting + internet cafe ISP; POPs Melbourne, Sydney, Perth; ISP brand wound down mid-2000s but company still trading (AINS Telecom, Palladium IT) (AUSTRALIA INTERNET SOLUTIONS PTY LTD, ACN 076 598 582).

events.details: AUSTRALIA INTERNET SOLUTIONS PTY LTD ACN 076598582 registered 29 Nov 1996; Founded 1996.

events.details: ains.net.au ISP site redirected to ains.com.au from c. 2003; last standalone capture Aug 2006. Company AUSTRALIA INTERNET SOLUTIONS PTY LTD (ACN 076 598 582, Werribee VIC) remains registered, later trading as AINS Telecom (2019) and Palladium IT / Advanced IT Services (2021).
